name: Physical Supremacy
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 5, antipaladin 4, bloodrager 4, cleric/oracle 5, druid 5, lathspell 4, magus 5, paladin 4, psychic 5, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5, unchained summoner 5

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, DF

Range touch

Target creature touched

Duration 1 min./level

Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

The subject becomes physically more powerful. The spell grants a +4 enhancement bonus to Strength, Dexterity and Constitution.
